title: Getting in without reading
persona: A careless typist who installed Jerv from a friend's link and wants to see their map, typing fast on a small phone.
goal: From the You tab, open sign-in and try it badly: empty fields, an email with no @, a very long email, a one-letter password, then Forgot password with a bad address. Open the privacy and support links and come back. Do not create an account.
success: Every bad attempt shows a clear message, and the app is back on the sign-in or You screen with nothing broken.
